question: Should #97904 stay open until maintainers have a redacted MiMo Discord payload capture, or is the existing `reasoning_content` source handling enough to close it?
rationale: The report is security-sensitive and the relevant safeguards already existed in the reported release, so automation cannot safely decide whether source inspection alone disproves the leak.

options.title: Require payload proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main or latest-release run captures provider deltas, transcript blocks, and outbound Discord payload for MiMo v2.5.

options.title: Close as covered by current handling
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept that existing MiMo `reasoning_content` handling fully covers the reported path without live payload evidence.

options.title: Patch Discord defensively
options.body: Add broader Discord-side suppression only if maintainers decide provider-level proof is impractical and accept the risk of hiding legitimate untagged text.

recommendation.title: Require payload proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main or latest-release run captures provider deltas, transcript blocks, and outbound Discord payload for MiMo v2.5.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Discord delivery and reasoning payload handling, where vincentkoc has the strongest recent merged history.
